title: Prisma/PostGIS migration baseline and isolated integration-test harness

target_symbols.reason: PostgreSQL datasource and generated Prisma Client baseline without premature domain models
migration-owned PostGIS and pgcrypto extension baseline
single DI-managed Prisma client lifecycle boundary
global Nest module that owns and exports PrismaService
isolated PostGIS, migration, DI lifecycle, and FK-safe cleanup evidence
FK-safe cleanup primitive restricted to an explicitly guarded test database

acceptance: Prisma is pinned and reproducibly generates a PostgreSQL client from apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma without introducing Auth, Organization, Property, Lead, Finance, or other premature domain models.
A committed migration baseline idempotently enables PostGIS and pgcrypto; btree_gist is not enabled before the viewing exclusion-constraint task.
A global DatabaseModule owns one injectable PrismaService and no controller or use-case constructs PrismaService directly.
The integration harness refuses any database outside the EF-102 loopback test boundary before destructive setup or cleanup.

Integration tests deploy the migration to the isolated estateflow_test database, prove PostGIS availability, create temporary parent/child fixtures, prove FK-safe cleanup, and remove fixture tables in finally cleanup.
No business schema, worker/outbox implementation, real customer data, secrets, deployment, commit, or push is introduced.
runtime_data_effects: Start only infra/compose/docker-compose.test.yml on loopback ports 55433 and 56380.
Apply EF-104 migration only to estateflow_test after scripts/assert-test-database.mjs passes with ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_TESTS=1.
Create and drop ef104_test_parent and ef104_test_child fixtures only inside estateflow_test.

commands: migration status and PostGIS SQL smoke against estateflow_test
